name: en_hallucinations
description: The model invents a requirement ID, a link lifetime nobody stated, a quote that is not in the document and a test case without a basis. None of it may be accepted.
requirements:
REQ-1: The system sends a confirmation email after registration.
REQ-2: The user must confirm the email address before the first login.
REQ-3: The confirmation link expires.

rule.missing_error_handling.REQ-2.value: Login is refused with a message to confirm the email first.

answers_by_text.value: A page offers to send a new confirmation email.

questions.question: Does REQ-7 apply to social sign-in?
Should the link expire after 48 hours?
What does the user see when opening an expired confirmation link?
questions.reason: The negative test needs the result.

findings.fix: State how long the link is valid.

test_cases.title: Link valid for two days
test_cases.expected_result: The email is confirmed within 48 hours.

test_cases.title: Login before confirmation
test_cases.expected_result: Login is refused with a message to confirm the email first.
test_cases.basis_quote: confirm the email address before the first login
